zh-CN.title: 小兜文件与文件夹分享
items: 小兜可切换列表和缩略图、刷新目录，返回上一级会恢复浏览位置
留幅相册改为独立聊天操作，时序的日历设置和打开入口更清楚

en.title: Share Pocklo files and folders
items: Switch Pocklo between list and thumbnail views, refresh a folder, and return to your previous position.
Open StillFolio albums directly from chat actions and manage Chronelle from its redesigned drawer.
